source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in 31 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W11819775B)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics active. Use ▲/▼ to reach the test number for this procedure; Freezer to enter.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 28
steps.body: In Service Diagnostic Mode use ▲/▼ to reach step 28. Press Freezer button to enter test. Amber step number; result on display.

steps.title: Enable condenser fan
steps.body: Select on/oF with ▲; confirm with Freezer. Speed modes 01–06 all run fan.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select on/oF with ▲; confirm with Freezer. Speed modes 01–06 all run fan.

steps.title: Condenser fan operation
steps.body: CN4-2 +12V to CN4-4 C-FAN = 12.7 VDC; CN4-6 C/PWM to CN4-4 = 3–6 VDC. Fan runs?
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN4-2 +12V to CN4-4 C-FAN = 12.7 VDC; CN4-6 C/PWM to CN4-4 = 3–6 VDC. Fan runs?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Condenser fan does not run with voltage present.

steps.title: Replace condenser fan
steps.oemOutcome: Replace condenser fan motor or repair harness.
